provenance.sampling: First generated volcanic candidate of each family encountered in lexicographically sorted saved nonempty regions; all 256 columns from candidate center chunk. Selection was based only on generated status, not model agreement.
notes: terrain_noise_height is ForgeCaps/tfc:chunk_data/surfaceHeight, the primary noise-height reference.
world_surface_top_y and top_block are actual saved WORLD_SURFACE block observations after generation, structures, plants and fluids.

ground_below_surface_fluid_* skips contiguous minecraft:water/lava and any tfc:fluid/* surface blocks. Waterlogged solids are retained as ground. saved_surface_biome is the saved quart biome containing WORLD_SURFACE topY.
No Minecraft launch, chunk generation or save writes.
provenance.array_index_layout: z_major_index_z_times_16_plus_x; verified from TFC 1.20.x Units.index(x,z) implementation: (x & 15) | ((z & 15) << 4).
provenance.cross_sample_design: For each deterministic family-first site, sample cardinal offsets at 64, 128, and 256 blocks where the saved destination chunk is FULL. These are controls/rim slope checks chosen without new-model comparison.

measurement_reference.model: Pre-centered-volcano-overlay geology model; reproduced by temporarily disabling only volcanic_height::Samplers::apply in a read-only copy of current source, leaving all other sampler code unchanged.
measurement_reference.height_quantization: Returned f64 prediction is truncated to i32 to match TFC final surfaceHeight cast before comparison.

provenance.ground_fluid_extraction: Skips only contiguous minecraft water/lava and IDs in tfc:fluid/*; waterlogged solids are not skipped.
provenance.biome_extraction: saved_surface_biome is the saved quart biome containing WORLD_SURFACE topY.
